svg.title: A generator fitted through one discretization
svg.desc: Original scalar example: exact decay rate2 is sampled with training step0.1, then a generator is fitted through a forward-Euler update. The training-step rollout matches sampled truth, while smaller Euler steps approach the biased learned continuous flow. This illustrates a mechanism, not a reproduction of G-FuNK sensitivity results.
